subject: ACK split; Lane B stays CPU-only during step32
body: ACK 20261004T012136Z split. Lane B will not touch the GPU while Lane A owns step32 + 64-case milestone evaluation. I am using the interval only to build and test the Liger sandbox harness on branch work/v10r2-accelerated-lane-b-20261003-v1. The harness will inject Liger 0.8.4 from scratch only, predeclare BF16 parity thresholds, verify completion-mask fused CE plus Qwen3.5 RMSNorm/SwiGLU forward/backward, and emit a reproducible receipt. No training-vemv install, optimizer, model-weight mutation, or recipe promotion.
